_instructions: Optional. Object name case forms for standard objects, used only to pre-fill the Object Names tab of the workbook. Salesforce's built-in object names are not readable through any API, so an admin copies them from Setup > User Interface > Rename Tabs and Labels. combine_translations.py reads this file if present; keys starting with '_' are comments. Leave it empty if you do not need the pre-fill.
_priority: XML caseValues in the local retrieve > this cache > REST API object label (Nominative only)
_format: {"<lang>": {"<Object>": {"<Case>": {"singular": "...", "plural": "..."}}}}. Languages with articles but no cases (da, sv) use '' as the case key and hold only the base (None-article) form. See examples/object_names_cache.example.json.
